**Status:** awaiting engineer approval (the ONE approval, OC-13)

## Original description

> A dashboard for the software factory itself: see cycle time, cost, model mix, and defect/review-round trends from the ledger and findings data. The factory builds its own visibility layer.

## Platform

Local web app (browser) + a THIN local data server (owner decision, round 2). The server is a minimal read-only HTTP service on 127.0.0.1 that serves the factory's JSONL data; it is NOT a product backend (no accounts, no writes, no business logic). Endpoints: GET /api/runs -> list of run dirs with ledger presence; GET /api/ledger?run=<id> -> raw ledger.jsonl rows as a JSON array; GET /api/findings -> findings.jsonl rows as a JSON array. Read-only: any non-GET -> 405. Binds loopback only; factory data never leaves the machine. The Vite dev server proxies /api to it; a static build talks to it at the same origin path.

## Stack

React + Vite + TypeScript; Vitest + Testing Library (jsdom). Charts via a lightweight lib (e.g. recharts) or hand-rolled SVG. Reads JSONL ledger + findings files.

## Features

- headline cards
- per-story table
- trend views
- run/repo scope selector

## Acceptance criteria (per feature)

- **headline cards:** Show total tokens, total cost (or 'not recorded' when cost unknown), total escaped defects (formula above), mean review rounds (factory-arm stories in scope, control excluded), and process-overhead ratio across the selected scope. Each card renders a real computed number or 'not recorded' — never 0 for missing data. Cards update when scope changes.
- **per-story table:** One row per story in scope: story id, arm/run, coder/non-coder tokens, overhead ratio, wall time, human-min (or 'not recorded'), escaped defects, review rounds, model(s). Sortable by rounds, escaped defects, and wall time (three sort columns; other columns static in v1). Nulls render 'not recorded', never 0. Matches factory/metrics.py harvest output.
- **trend views:** Three charts: review-rounds-per-story, escaped-defects-per-story (both over the run sequence, factory arm), plus model-mix breakdown (tokens per model). Charts render from real data; empty scope shows a friendly empty state, not a blank axis. Tooltips show exact values. Cycle-time-over-time trend is DEFERRED to v2 (cycle time is visible as wall_s in the table; owner chose the middle feature tier).
- **run/repo scope selector:** Selector options are DISCOVERED from GET /api/runs (the wireframe's hardcoded list is illustrative only); default = all. Changing scope recomputes cards/table/trends from that subset only. Selection persists across reload via 'factory-dash:prefs'. A scope with no data shows the empty state, not stale numbers. The composite view renders the selector ABOVE the data views and all views react to it.

## Data model

Reads existing schemas, defines no new write model. Ledger row (schema 0): {event, ts, story, role, repo, sha, model, tokens{in,out}, cost_usd, wall_s, human_min, outcome, detail, prev}. Finding row: {ts, repo, pr, round, source, klass, severity, summary, path, head_sha, escaped_gate, escaped_review, verified, disposition, fix_sha, gate_check}. DERIVED METRICS (exact formulas): (1) Escaped defects per repo = count of findings rows where (escaped_gate OR escaped_review) is true AND klass != 'false-positive' AND disposition != 'rejected' AND summary does NOT start with 'RESOLVED' (resolution markers are records, not defects). Source is state/findings.jsonl, NOT ledger defect_found events (those count in-loop findings, a different metric). (2) Per-story tokens/wall/human-min = factory/metrics.py harvest() semantics over dispatch_completed (+correction re-attribution). (3) Overhead ratio = noncoder_tokens / coder_tokens (None when coder_tokens == 0). (4) Mean review rounds = mean over FACTORY-arm stories in scope (control excluded: single-pass, not reviewable). (5) Review rounds per story = max round in findings for that story's PR + 1 pre-PR round when present, else from ledger loop_converged detail.rounds. Data-quality note: the SKEL-1 narrative said '6 escaped defects' for control; the formula above yields 7 finding rows (two nits were narratively grouped). The formula is authoritative; the dashboard shows 7.

## Persistence

READ-ONLY invariant: neither the dashboard nor the data server ever writes ledger/findings/state. The server reads runs/*/ledger.jsonl and state/findings.jsonl from the local factory repo on each request (always fresh). UI prefs (selected scope) persist in localStorage key 'factory-dash:prefs' only. On unreadable/corrupt file: the server returns {error: '<file>: <reason>'} with 200 for that source; the UI shows a per-source error state (file + reason), never crashes, never fabricates numbers. Nulls render 'not recorded', never 0.

## Look and feel

Match the factory's existing warm-paper theme (light + dark, contrast-audited AA). Consistent with the to-do demo palette; calm, readable, charts subordinate to numbers.

## Assumptions & resolved ambiguities

v1 is READ-ONLY visibility — no editing, no dispatch triggers, no board writes (controller's job, OC-14). Cost: tokens-only until a trusted price table exists; cost_usd null/0 -> 'not recorded'. WHEN a price table lands: cost = sum over dispatches of model_rate_usd_per_1k * (tokens_in + tokens_out) / 1000, keyed by model name; unknown-model dispatches render 'not recorded'; USD shown to 2 decimal places. Cycle-time trend chart deferred to v2 (documented cut, M3). Live tailing/websockets OUT of scope (server is request/response, always fresh on reload). Per-dispatch drill-down and findings-mining views deferred. No authentication (loopback-only server). The thin data server is infrastructure, not a product backend: read-only GET, loopback bind, no state.
